Text-to-speech with explicit MP3 response format

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val req = mapper.readValue("{\"input\":\"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.\",\"model\":\"tts-1-hd\",\"response_format\":\"mp3\",\"speed\":1.0,\"voice\":\"nova\"}", CreateSpeechRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.speech(req)
    println(result.audio)
}
```
